title: Introducing TSC Originals — create something together
body:
Your idea. Your favourite musicians. Something original.

TSC Originals brings musicians together to turn ideas into finished music. Start your own project, join an existing collaboration or invite colleagues you’d love to create with.

Start wherever you are

You might have a melody, a bass line, some lyrics or a rough demo. You might only have a voice note explaining the feel you’re after.

Upload what you have and describe your direction. You can give musicians a clear brief or keep things open-ended with a genre and room to experiment.

Build your team

Invite your favourite colleagues from The Supreme Collective or bring in musicians from outside TSC. They can create an account and join your collaboration.

You can also browse projects, recommend someone for a role or reserve a future place before that instrument’s recording round opens.

A clear route from idea to finished track

Projects move through instrument recording rounds, then mixing and mastering. The aim is to keep collaborations moving swiftly, with everyone able to see what’s needed next.

Listen to the approved stems, adjust their levels and download a reference mix to record against. Follow the recording tips, upload your part and check its alignment before submitting.

You can include up to four stems — for example, two different ideas, each with a clean version and a version with effects. Recording reservations normally give you 24 hours once activated, with an option to request more time.

Project chat keeps ideas and questions together. Owners can give feedback and request revisions when a recording needs another pass.

The owner keeps the creative direction

The project owner decides which recordings and sections are accepted into the final track.

Musicians who are not selected will be informed, and unselected recordings will not be used.

Free participation, with contributions recorded

There’s no fee to take part. Accepted contributions and agreed royalty shares are recorded in the project, with recording royalties and songwriting credit handled separately under the project agreements.

You’ll receive a PDF copy of your signed agreement. Any royalties due through TSC will be paid twice a year.

Helping the finished music find an audience

TSC will manage and oversee finished releases and pursue suitable opportunities through streaming, downloads, publishing, sync licensing, broadcast and public-play income.

We’ll develop creative social content and targeted promotion for releases with a strong audience fit, alongside exploring festivals and other original live-performance projects.

Ready to try it?

Start with something small: share an idea, invite a musician colleague or record a part for a project that interests you.

Explore TSC Originals
